posts.text:
I built my own Wispr Flow alternative after my subscription expired.
Now I finally recorded it working end-to-end.
The interesting part isn't just speech → text.
It runs locally on macOS and handles the messy parts that make voice dictation actually usable:
→ Captures ~1s before you start speaking
→ Silero VAD removes pauses and silence
→ Cleans up filler words automatically
→ Understands commands like “scratch that”
→ Adapts formatting based on the app you're typing into
→ Works completely offline
The goal was simple:
Talk naturally.
Stop thinking about the keyboard.
Get clean text where your cursor is.
I put together a short video showing the actual workflow instead of another list of features.

Download link : https://lnkd.in/gp5uKsr6
GitHub: https://lnkd.in/gXPziB-G

Would love to know what you'd add to a local-first dictation tool.

I thought the hard part of a distributed coding agent was the LLM loop.

It wasn’t.

The hard part is what happens when two backend servers both think they own the same sandbox.

One server starts the agent.
Another receives a follow-up request for the same project.
Both try to write tools, stream tokens, and mutate the sandbox at the same time.

Race conditions, lost heartbeats, stale locks, and half-applied state.

So the design had to treat sandbox ownership as a first-class distributed problem:

- Redis locks + TTL + heartbeats so ownership can expire cleanly
- Project → sandbox mapping that survives backend death
- Background workers + Redis Streams for the streaming agent loop
- Database as source of truth
- Object storage snapshots for recovery
- Explicit ownership transfer instead of hoping the process is still alive

An AI coding agent is not a single Node process.
It is a distributed system that happens to call an LLM.

Curious how others are handling multi-server ownership of long-running agent sandboxes.

Since my Wispr Flow subscription expired last month, I decided not to renew it and instead thought, why not build my own? So, I created a native macOS voice-to-text application.

Link: https://lnkd.in/gzM-3Nc5

- Fast, private dictation for macOS.
- Captures ~1s before you start speaking
- Removes pauses with Silero VAD
- Automatically cleans up fillers
- Understands “scratch that”
- Adapts formatting to the app you're using
- Runs entirely offline All local. All yours.

Give it a try! 
⭐ Star it on GitHub: https://lnkd.in/gXPziB-G
